# Getting Fund

The lab may be able to advise on grant or conference support, including opportunities associated with FNRS. Eligibility, deadlines, and allowable expenses depend on the scheme and can change. Check the current funder and institutional pages, and speak with the lab administrator or supervisor before making commitments.

## Funding for research projects

- [Wallonia-Brussels International (WBI)](https://www.wbi.be/en/WBI-World-EN)

## Funding for conferences or travel
